chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام narrated from his mother and Umm Ahmad ibn Musa عليه السلام; they said:

We were with Abū al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام in the desert while we were heading to Baghdad. So he said to us on Thursday, 'Perform ghusl today for tomorrow, Friday, for the water there will be scarce tomorrow.' They said: So we performed ghusl on Thursday for Jumu'ah.

key_terms.ٱغْتَسِلَا: Perform ghusl; a direct instruction to carry out the ritual bath
key_terms.ٱلْبَادِيَةِ: The desert; the travel setting in which the event took place
key_terms.ٱلْجُمُعَةِ: Friday; here referring to the day for which the ghusl is intended
key_terms.ٱلْخَمِيسِ: Thursday; the day on which the ghusl was performed in advance
key_terms.ٱلْمَاءَ: Water; the practical reason mentioned for advancing the ghusl

ai.seo_question: Can ghusl for Jumu'ah be performed on Thursday if water may not be available on Friday?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليه السلام instructed the women traveling with him to perform ghusl on Thursday in preparation for Friday because water would be scarce the next day. It indicates practical facilitation regarding the ghusl of Jumu'ah and reflects attentiveness to conditions during travel.
